sections.chapter_title: Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)
sections.section_title: FDCAN Tx buffer transmission occurred register (FDCAN_TXBTO)
sections.text_helper: Section 71.5.40 "FDCAN Tx buffer transmission occurred register (FDCAN_TXBTO)" in chapter 71 (Controller area network with flexible data rate (FDCAN)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3713.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x00D8
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:0 TO[31:0]: Transmission occurred
Each Tx buffer has its own transmission occurred bit. The bits are set when the corresponding
FDCAN_TXBRP bit is cleared after a successful transmission. The bits are reset when a new
transmission is requested by writing a 1 to the corresponding bit of register FDCAN_TXBAR.
0: No transmission occurred
1: Transmission occurred
